{{Quote|The Church revered the Sun-in-Splendour before it was divided - but even while it was still whole, its later selves were recognized as its Names. The Madrugad, of course, presided over death and the passage into the House.|''Sunset Passages''}}
'''The Madrugad''' is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XIV, or 2:00pm. Her [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}, and {{Lore|Winter}}. She is one of the four offspring of [[The Sun-in-Splendour]]. The [[Church of the Unconquered Sun]] honored The Madrugad by speaking the White Ceremony "at funerals held in the chilly space before dawn."


Reckoners invoke the Madrugad to trade in years. She oversees the Cindered Tally.
